value.name: Micky snaps back at Charlene
value.description: Micky angrily rejects Charlene's implication and insists he is alone in the ring.
evidence: MICKY snaps, 'What's the difference, I'm alone in the ring anyway.'

value.name: Charlene questions family loyalty
value.description: Charlene challenges Micky by asking whether his family is really looking out for him.
evidence: CHARLENE challenges, 'You think your family's lookin' out for ya?'

value.name: Micky defends his family
value.description: Micky takes offense at Charlene's criticism and insists she cannot speak that way about his family.
evidence: 'You can't say that about my family.'

value.name: Charlene confronts Micky's condition
value.description: Charlene holds Micky's gaze and points to his battered face, implying his family has failed him.
evidence: 'What else could I say after what you told me? Look at your face, look at you.'

value.name: Micky kisses Charlene
value.description: After a tense pause, Micky leans in and kisses Charlene, turning the confrontation into a moment of intense romantic connection.
evidence: A beat. He suddenly leans in and kisses her.
The kiss builds with confidence and passion, escalating into a moment of intense connection, abandon, and unspoken promise.
